requirements.text: Strong on-camera presentation skills and clear, confident communication
Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
Strong research skills and verifying information before presenting it
AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools
Basic video editing and preparing footage
Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada
Previous experience creating educational video content
Knowledge of website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or similar topics

resumes.text:
Jordan Mills
Remote creator and educator

Summary
Native English speaker and online educator with five years of experience making tutorials for beginners. I enjoy simplifying technical topics and staying current with new software tools. Authorized to work in the United States. Reliable and organized, and comfortable working independently.

Experience
Senior Tutorial Producer, Tidewater Learning (2021 to present)
- Wrote scripts and outlines for 80 software tutorials, each reviewed for accuracy before release.
- Recorded talking-head and screen recordings for weekly lessons.
- Cut footage, added captions and b-roll in Premiere before handing projects to editors.
- Hosted weekly live webinars for 300 attendees, adjusting delivery based on audience feedback.
- Turned dense technical guides into plain-language walkthroughs for first-time users.
- Verified sources before publishing every lesson.
- Produced tutorials on Shopify and ecommerce store setup for small merchants.

Freelance Writer, Various Clients (2018 to 2021)
- Wrote product documentation and blog posts for small software companies.

Education
B.A. in English, Cedar Hill University, 2018

Skills
Public speaking, scripting, Premiere, Shopify, Chrome, screen capture tools. Occasional use of ChatGPT for email drafts. Reliable laptop and fast home internet.

Sam Pruitt

Summary
Marketing coordinator with four years of experience in brand communications. Strong on-camera presence from hosting internal and public events. Fluent in English and Spanish, with professional working proficiency in both. Authorized to work in Canada.

Experience
Marketing Coordinator, Northline Outdoor Co. (2022 to present)
- Manage the monthly newsletter and social media calendar.
- Built slide decks for internal employee onboarding.
- Produced weekly product announcements that reached 40,000 subscribers.
- Hosted quarterly product demos on camera for regional retailers.

Freelance Copywriter (2019 to 2022)
- Wrote scripts for two local radio spots and a series of short product clips.
- Cross-checked each claim against two primary sources before publishing.

Education
Bachelor of Arts in Communications, Harbor University, 2019

Skills
Copywriting, presentations, Canva, Mailchimp, screen recordings for product walkthroughs.

Greg Holloway
Senior Accountant

Summary
Accountant with eight years of experience in manufacturing finance. Strong in month-end close, cost analysis, and audit preparation. Native English speaker and authorized to work in the United States.

Experience
Senior Accountant, Ridgeline Fabrication (2019 to present)
- Own the month-end close for three plants and a 40 million dollar revenue base.
- Presented quarterly budget reports to executives and the board.
- Reconciled bank accounts and vendor ledgers for external audits.
- Reduced close time from 12 days to 7 days by standardizing journal entries.
- Partner with operations leads on cost reviews, and present analysis to non-finance teams.

Accountant, Keystone Industrial Supply (2016 to 2019)
- Prepared payroll tax filings and accounts payable reports.
- Managed a team of two junior bookkeepers.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Accounting, Eastfield State University, 2016

Skills
General ledger systems, Excel, cost accounting, audit preparation, payroll compliance. Reliable laptop and home internet connection.
